newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Kuwait-based Arab fund lends Morocco $23 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait-based Arab fund lends Morocco $23 mln.

text.p: Kuwait-based Economic and Social Arab Development Fund on Monday granted a Moroccan state electricity company the equivalent of 210 million dirhams ($22.8 million) to build a power line.

The loan will finance the Office Nationale de l'Electricite to acquire equipments for building a 220 km (140 miles)-long power line between the northeastern towns of Matmata and Bourdin, the office said in a statement.
The fund had already lent the Moroccan Office the equivalent of 555 million dirhams to finance two other power lines.
The office said it planned to invest 2.3 billion dirhams for upgrading and expanding the country's power network, 40 percent of which will be financed by the fund.
